checks.expected: At least one complete render proof with exact matching encoded-video payload
Every creation PNG is1920x1080and byte-identical to its proof

visual_scope: Decoded captures and source-PNG checks only. A separate person/agent must inspect them; this script does not certify comprehension or naturalness.

streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

all_frame_timestamp_scan.meaning: All video packet PTS/DTS/durations checked as integers. Packets are in decode/DTS order; sortedPTS are in presentation order. Negative starting DTS is allowed codec delay, not a cadence failure.

native_resolution_proof_scope: Creation PNG dimensions+SHA, full frame trace, raw1080creation command and exact encoded-video-payload link to deliveredMP4. Video dimensions alone were not used as proof of native rendering.
reader_capture_method: Capture every first rendered raster/source-data state and its neighbouringframes, plus every actual shot boundary. Thus retained reader-display transitions are included as a superset; these are montage frame indices, not guessed conversions of Native ticks.
full_decode_scope: Every video frame and the complete mapped audio stream decoded once with-xerror/-err_detect explode. The same decode produces the selected PNGs; no auditory evaluation or native reproduction is implied.
